opened.used_for: Monic coprime factorization over a henselian local ring without a Noetherian hypothesis.
Every central division algebra has finite separable splitting field. A finite division algebra over separably closed k has purely inseparable separably closed center, hence equals its center.

proof_scope: Full proofs in A_finish_fpqc_solution; no claim that the endomorphism algebra is finite over A; no claim that raw B tensor strict henselization to its t-henselization is faithful.
